bakery:pickup-news.title: Today’s bread and pickup information
bakery:pickup-news.summary: Freshly prepared breads and a quick note on collecting your order.
bakery:pickup-news.cover_alt: Paper bags and freshly baked bread
bakery:pickup-news.markdown:
Today we have a small selection of focaccia, rolls and sweet breads made with seasonal fruit.

Some are packed in bags, while others are in baskets at the counter. If you reserved bread, please give us your name when you arrive.

![Today's bread](bakery/pickup.webp)

*This is a fictional announcement for the demo.*

bakery:apple-walnut.title: New for autumn: apple and walnut bread
bakery:apple-walnut.summary: A seasonal loaf made with tart apples and fragrant walnuts.
bakery:apple-walnut.cover_alt: A sliced apple and walnut loaf
bakery:apple-walnut.markdown:
We baked a moist loaf with tangy apples and aromatic walnuts. Little pieces of apple are tucked into the crumb.

## How to enjoy it

- Toast lightly to bring out the aroma
- Add a little butter
- Enjoy with your morning coffee

![Apple and walnut bread](bakery/apple-bread.webp)

bakery:market-thanks.title: Thank you for visiting our weekend market
bakery:market-thanks.summary: A lovely autumn day of handing our bread directly to visitors.
bakery:market-thanks.cover_alt: Bread stall at an autumn market
bakery:market-thanks.markdown:
We joined a small market on a weekend when the autumn leaves were beginning to change.

Some visitors stopped by because of the smell of fresh bread; others asked about serving and storing it. Meeting everyone in person is the best reward.

![Our market stall](bakery/market.webp)

Next time we hope to bring more walnut bread and seasonal pastries.

bakery:winter-music.title: Winter bread and an intimate music gathering
bakery:winter-music.summary: An invitation to a peaceful afternoon of fresh bread and acoustic music.
bakery:winter-music.cover_alt: An intimate gathering with bread and music
bakery:winter-music.markdown:
As the light through the windows softens, we are planning a gathering to enjoy bread and music together.

## About the little concert

Fresh bread, warm drinks and acoustic music: we hope to create a gentle afternoon.

![Bread and music gathering](bakery/winter-music.webp)

*This is a fictional event. No date or booking details have been set.*

bakery:bread-notes.title: Notes from the bakery: what’s next
bakery:bread-notes.summary: Ideas for seasonal bread and small gatherings as autumn turns to winter.
bakery:bread-notes.cover_alt: An idea notebook on a kitchen table
bakery:bread-notes.markdown:
We spread our notebooks out on the kitchen table and jot down breads we would like to bake and small gatherings we hope to hold.

## Ideas we’re exploring

- Seasonal bread with apples and walnuts
- Taking part in a neighborhood market
- A peaceful afternoon around bread and warm drinks

![Bakery idea notebook](bakery/season.webp)
